selection_policy: Census templates <=12 titles; ceil(log2(n+1)) seeded random titles per other template; cover each length, grammar-character first/last boundary, rare-character presence per template; census list/count characters and complete grammar tokens within slots. Overlapping selections deduplicated.
boundary_characters: 与事人任位准及同名和复志意批核格理等管董资高
rare_character_definition: Character appears in <=2 unique missing-reference titles; not a surname/name rule.
interpretation: Purposeful semantic-error search, not a representative accuracy estimate. Blind input includes only original title and identifier; no slot, template, risk or script output.
